title: [Core] Default to using per_token quantization for fp8 when cutlass is supported. (#8651)

experiments.name: fp8_per_token_apply
experiments.workload: Llama2-7B on H100, full serving throughput benchmark; fp8 dynamic quant with cutlass supported so dequant+amax fuse into the cutlass gemm.
experiments.note: Diff flips use_per_token_if_dynamic from False to self.cutlass_fp8_supported in Fp8LinearMethod.apply (fp8.py), enabling fused amax+quantization. Number source: PR body H100 Llama2-7B throughput 10681.75 -> 11181.40 tok/s (~4.68%).

reported.scope: end-to-end H100 Llama2-7B serving throughput over the whole model, not the isolated apply() call the diff touches
reported.scale_short: Author's number is full-model E2E serving throughput; the diff only changes one quant flag in the fp8 linear apply path. TO MAKE 1:1: run an isolated fp8 cutlass gemm+quant microbench on the changed apply() call, not whole-model serving.
reported.scale_note: SAME unit (tok/s) but the 10681.75 -> 11181.40 figure is whole-model H100 Llama2-7B serving throughput, diluted by attention, KV cache and all non-fp8 work; the diff only fuses amax+quantization inside the cutlass fp8 gemm path. Direction genuine; absolute magnitude not 1:1 with an isolated-op bench.
